item.title: NTSB chair slams House aviation bill as ‘watered-down’ after 67 deaths near Washington
item.description: Jennifer Homendy said the House bill’s “watered-down” requirements wouldn’t do enough to prevent a tragedy.

item.title: Republican voter ID bill stalls in Senate despite Trump demands
item.description: Thune says he supports the legislation and his conference is discussing how to pass it.

item.title: Novartis settles with Henrietta Lacks’ estate over use of her ‘stolen’ cells to advance medicine
item.description: The agreement was finalized in federal court this month, but details aren’t public.

item.title: Deposed Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro asks judge to toss out indictment against him
item.description: Nicolas Maduro's attorney filed papers in Manhattan federal court, saying the U.S. government has violated his client’s due process rights by blocking funds to defend him that should come from the Venezuelan government.

item.title: US military used laser to take down Border Protection drone, lawmakers say
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser to shoot down a Customs and Border Protection drone, according to members of Congress, and the FAA responded by closing more airspace near El Paso, Texas.

item.title: Heat rally comes up short in critical 124-117 loss in Philadelphia in play-in chase
item.description: The victories over Pelicans, Hawks and Grizzlies that gave the Heat the 3-game winning streak going into the week were window dressing. Losses like Thursday are what matter for the Heat.

item.title: Winderman’s view: In Heat loss, 76ers’ Edgecombe a reminder of the occasional dip into lottery waters
item.description: Ira Winderman's perspectives and other items of note from the Miami Heat's Thursday night game against the Philadelphia 76ers.

item.title: Marchand scores twice as Panthers get important win over Maple Leafs
item.description: Olympian Brad Marchand scored twice as the Panthers rolled to a crucial victory over Toronto in their first game back from the Olympic break.

item.title: Broadway in Miami next season to feature ‘Great Gatsby,’ ‘Buena Vista Social Club,’ ‘Jersey Boys’
item.description: "The Great Gatsby" and "Buena Vista Social Club" will get their regional debut at the Arsht Center (with the latter then moving to the Broward Center for a run).
